name: Neon
description: Neon lets agents list projects and branches, read table schemas, run read-only SQL, find slow queries, and search the Neon docs. Each user signs in to their own Neon account through the browser. The server runs in read-only mode, so agents cannot create or delete projects and branches, run migrations or read connection strings.

prompts.text: Which tables are in my Neon database, and how do they relate?
Which queries are the slowest in my Neon database?
Which branches does each of my Neon projects have?

apps.name: Neon
apps.description: Projects, branches, schemas, and read-only SQL, over Neon's MCP server with browser sign-in.
